project.title: Design and Rollout of Inclusive Hiring and Onboarding Framework
project.objective: Create and implement a standardized, inclusive hiring and onboarding framework to improve candidate experience, compliance, and early retention across all business units.
deliverables: Documented end-to-end hiring and onboarding process map
Standardized job posting and interview toolkit
Inclusive hiring and anti-bias guideline for recruiters and managers
HR metrics dashboard definition for hiring and onboarding KPIs
constraints: Framework must comply with labour legislation and employment law in all operating regions
Go-live must be achievable with existing HRIS and no new major tools
Processes must support employability of people with disabilities and ensure gender equality
All templates must be understandable by non-HR managers
Pilot must be completed before full rollout

risks.risk: New process increases time-to-hire and frustrates hiring managers.
risks.mitigation: Design lean approval steps, gather early feedback from pilot managers, and adjust SLAs.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with local labour legislation in some regions.
risks.mitigation: Have legal consultant review all templates and processes before rollout and after pilot feedback.

risks.risk: Low adoption of new onboarding steps by line managers.
risks.mitigation: Create simple checklists, short training, and track completion with gentle reminders.

risks.risk: Accessibility needs of candidates with disabilities not fully addressed.
risks.mitigation: Consult internal disability support resources and update guidelines with concrete accommodations examples.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures consistent candidate experience and easier training of HR staff and managers.
Hiring and onboarding must comply with labour legislation and employment law.
Supports gender equality and employability of people with disabilities.
Structured onboarding reduces early turnover and employee complaints.
Data and feedback from employees and managers will drive continuous improvement.

backlog.task: Map current hiring and onboarding processes across business units
definition_of_done: Process map drafted for all major hiring steps from requisition to 90 days post-hire
Key pain points and variations documented
Reviewed and validated by at least two human resources assistants

backlog.task: Draft standardized job posting and interview templates
definition_of_done: Job posting template created with inclusive language guidelines
Structured interview guide and scorecard drafted for generic roles
Templates reviewed by one human resources manager and legal consultant

backlog.task: Create inclusive hiring and anti-bias guideline for managers
definition_of_done: Guideline document covers bias awareness, disability accommodations, and gender equality
Examples of compliant and non-compliant practices included
Legal consultant signs off on compliance aspects

backlog.task: Design onboarding checklist and 90-day integration plan
definition_of_done: Onboarding checklist covers pre-boarding, first week, first month, and 90 days
Checklist includes steps for people with disabilities and remote hires
Validated by at least one business unit manager and one human resources manager

backlog.task: Align new framework with payroll and HRIS processes
definition_of_done: Touchpoints with payroll and HRIS identified and documented
No additional manual steps added without justification
Payroll specialist confirms feasibility and timelines

backlog.task: Define hiring and onboarding KPIs and reporting cadence
definition_of_done: List of KPIs agreed (e.g., time-to-hire, offer acceptance, 90-day retention)
Data sources and owners identified
Reporting cadence and audience documented

backlog.task: Prepare communication and training plan for managers
definition_of_done: Short training deck and quick reference guide created
FAQ section drafted based on anticipated manager questions
Plan for at least two pilot training sessions scheduled

backlog.task: Run pilot of new framework with selected business unit
definition_of_done: Pilot scope and timeline agreed with business unit manager
At least three roles hired using new process
Feedback gathered from candidates, managers, and HR staff

backlog.task: Collect and analyze feedback from employees and candidates
definition_of_done: Feedback survey or interview script prepared
Responses from at least 10 participants collected
Summary of key themes and improvement suggestions documented

backlog.task: Update framework based on pilot results and finalize for rollout
definition_of_done: List of changes derived from pilot feedback agreed
All affected templates and guidelines updated
Final version shared with stakeholders for sign-off

backlog.task: Create escalation path for hiring and onboarding issues
definition_of_done: Common issue types and owners documented
Simple escalation flow created and shared with HR team
Contact points validated and kept up to date

backlog.task: Document governance and review cycle for the framework
definition_of_done: Ownership of framework clearly assigned
Review frequency and criteria defined
Change log template prepared for future updates

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success criteria, and responsibilities for the framework project.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for confirmation on scope and roles.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final project scope and out-of-scope items for the framework.
Confirm role ownership for each major workstream and backlog task.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and validate standardized hiring templates and inclusive guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: human resources assistant shares first draft of job posting and interview toolkit for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standardized job posting and interview templates for pilot use.
Sign off on the inclusive hiring and anti-bias guideline content.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize onboarding checklist, 90-day plan, and integration with payroll/HRIS.
threads_plan.trigger: human resources assistant posts draft onboarding checklist and asks for feedback on feasibility.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the onboarding checklist and 90-day integration plan for pilot.
Agree on any required changes to payroll and HRIS touchpoints.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and monitor the pilot, including training and communication to managers.
threads_plan.trigger: human resources manager proposes pilot business unit and tentative dates.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the business unit and timeframe for the pilot rollout.
Approve the manager communication and training plan for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot feedback, agree on adjustments, and confirm final rollout plan.
threads_plan.trigger: human resources assistant shares pilot feedback summary and proposed changes.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the list of framework changes based on pilot feedback.
Confirm go-live date and governance model for ongoing updates.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on top three priorities and blockers for the project.
Twice-weekly review of open tasks and upcoming deadlines against the backlog.
Weekly summary post with decisions made, risks, and next steps.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and improvement ideas.
